steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Gradient of a graph: The rate of change. Calculated by finding the change in y divided by the change in x. | Area under a graph: Can represent important quantities in real contexts (e.g., distance for velocity-time graphs).

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: On a distance-time graph, what does the gradient represent? | On a velocity-time graph, what does the gradient represent? | On a velocity-time graph, what does the area under the graph represent?
